notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
When the Saprolings enter the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers that many times, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
